scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.worker: npm run build -w @codeforge/execution && npm run dev -w apps/worker
scripts.runners:build: docker build -t codeforge-runner-javascript:1 runners/javascript && docker build -t codeforge-runner-python:1 runners/python && docker build -t codeforge-runner-cpp:1 runners/cpp
